mapper.select: SELECT A.USERID AS username, A.EMAIL AS email, A.FIRSTNAME AS firstName, A.LASTNAME AS lastName, A.STATUS AS status, A.ADDR1 AS address1, A.ADDR2 AS address2, A.CITY AS city, A.STATE AS state, A.ZIP AS zip, A.COUNTRY AS country, A.PHONE AS phone, P.FAVCATEGORY AS favouriteCategoryId, P.LANGPREF AS languagePreference FROM ACCOUNT A LEFT JOIN PROFILE P ON P.USERID = A.USERID ORDER BY A.USERID

SELECT A.USERID AS username, A.EMAIL AS email, A.FIRSTNAME AS firstName, A.LASTNAME AS lastName, A.STATUS AS status, A.ADDR1 AS address1, A.ADDR2 AS address2, A.CITY AS city, A.STATE AS state, A.ZIP AS zip, A.COUNTRY AS country, A.PHONE AS phone, P.FAVCATEGORY AS favouriteCategoryId, P.LANGPREF AS languagePreference FROM ACCOUNT A LEFT JOIN PROFILE P ON P.USERID = A.USERID WHERE A.USERID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR A.EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR A.FIRSTNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR A.LASTNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY A.USERID

SELECT A.USERID AS username, A.EMAIL AS email, A.FIRSTNAME AS firstName, A.LASTNAME AS lastName, A.STATUS AS status, A.ADDR1 AS address1, A.ADDR2 AS address2, A.CITY AS city, A.STATE AS state, A.ZIP AS zip, A.COUNTRY AS country, A.PHONE AS phone, P.FAVCATEGORY AS favouriteCategoryId, P.LANGPREF AS languagePreference FROM ACCOUNT A LEFT JOIN PROFILE P ON P.USERID = A.USERID WHERE A.USERID = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE ACCOUNT SET EMAIL = #{email}, FIRSTNAME = #{firstName}, LASTNAME = #{lastName}, STATUS = #{status}, ADDR1 = #{address1}, ADDR2 = #{address2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CITY = #{city}, STATE = #{state}, ZIP = #{zip}, COUNTRY = #{country}, PHONE = #{phone} WHERE USERID = #{username}
UPDATE SIGNON SET PASSWORD = #{password} WHERE USERNAME = #{username}
